sentences.text: I cannot verify the EMI for a loan of INR 10,00,000 at 9% for 120 months from the provided evidence, because the in-force loan document instead shows a different home loan with a sanctioned amount of ₹25,00,000, an interest rate of 8.5% p.a. floating, a loan term of 240 months, and an EMI amount of ₹21,696.

The bank documents define EMI as the equated monthly instalment payable towards interest and principal, and the loan agreement and its copy both state that the loan is repaid in 240 monthly instalments with the EMI on the date of sanction being ₹21,696.

The evidence does not include a rule finding that applies to the requested 10,00,000 / 9% / 120-month scenario, and the only in-force EMI figures on record are for the different loan described in the home loan documents.
